packageRules.description: Node: .nvmrc and the Dockerfile's base image move together
@actual-app/api and the actual-server image (dev stack, e2e) move together; the README names the supported version
OpenTelemetry packages require matching versions of each other (api, SDK, exporters, instrumentations), so they move together
Biome's schema URL in biome.json follows the package
runs-on and matrix runner labels move together

customManagers.description: Runner labels in job matrices (runner: ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm), which the github-actions manager only reads from runs-on
